abilities.name: Flower Pick
abilities.text: Tosses 1 jade tile from the suit with the fewest tiles in hand to deal Quantum DMG equal to 1% of Qingque's ATK to a single enemy.

abilities.name: A Scoop of Moon
abilities.text: Immediately draws 2 jade tile(s) and increases DMG by 0.28% until the end of the current turn. This effect can stack up to 4 time(s). The turn will not end after this Skill is used.

abilities.name: A Quartet? Woo-hoo!
abilities.text: Deals Quantum DMG equal to 2% of Qingque's ATK to all enemies, and obtains 4 jade tiles of the same suit.

abilities.name: Celestial Jade
abilities.text:
When an ally's turn starts, Qingque randomly draws 1 tile from 3 different suits and can hold up to 4 tiles at one time.
If Qingque starts her turn with 4 tiles of the same suit, she consumes all tiles to enter the "Hidden Hand" state.
While in this state, Qingque cannot use her Skill again. At the same time, Qingque's ATK increases by 0.72%, and her Basic ATK "Flower Pick" is enhanced, becoming "Cherry on Top!" The "Hidden Hand" state ends after using "Cherry on Top!".

abilities.name: Game Solitaire
abilities.text: After using Technique, Qingque draws 2 jade tile(s) when the battle starts.

abilities.name: Tile Battle
abilities.desc: Restores 1 Skill Point when using the Skill. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per battle.

abilities.name: Bide Time
abilities.desc: Using the Skill increases DMG Boost effect of attacks by an extra 10%.

abilities.name: Winning Hand
abilities.desc: Qingque's SPD increases by 10% for 1 turn after using the Enhanced Basic ATK.

abilities.name: Sleep on the Tiles
abilities.desc: Every time Draw Tile is triggered, Qingque immediately regenerates 1 Energy.

abilities.name: Read Between the Tiles
abilities.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

abilities.name: Right on the Tiles
abilities.desc: After this character's Skill is used, there is a 24% fixed chance to gain Autarky, which lasts until the end of the current turn. With Autarky, using Basic ATK or Enhanced Basic ATK immediately launches 1 follow-up attack on the same target, dealing Quantum DMG equal to 100% of the previous Basic ATK (or Enhanced Basic ATK)'s DMG.

abilities.name: Gambit for the Tiles
abilities.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

abilities.name: Prevail Beyond the Tiles
abilities.desc: Recovers 1 Skill Point after using Enhanced Basic ATK.
